title: Carousel
description: Scrolls slides sideways or up and down, with previous and next buttons, dots that jump to a slide and a bar that shows how far the shopper has scrolled.

components.Carousel: Groups all parts of the carousel, which scrolls through items sideways.
components.CarouselContent: Holds the slides of the carousel in a scrollable row.
components.CarouselDots: Shows one dot per slide and lets the user jump to a slide.
components.CarouselItem: Holds the content of one slide in the carousel.
components.CarouselNext: Lets the user scroll the carousel to the next slide.
components.CarouselPrevious: Lets the user scroll the carousel to the previous slide.
components.CarouselProgress: Shows how far the user has scrolled through the carousel.
